description: Independent reference (LPC.PC.21a) for the import graph built by tools/test_impact.py. Derived by hand by the planner (claude-opus-5-5, WU-0011.2, 2026-10-10) from the import statements of lpcstudy/*.py, including function-level imports and 'from . import x', before the tool existed. Key: module stem; value: sorted lpcstudy modules it imports directly, at any scope. Update by hand in the same change as any import edit; never from tool output. 2026-10-10 (WU-0001, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the seeds and provenance rows and the changed __main__ edges (seeds, provenance) were added by hand from the import statements in WU-0001.1 and .4; source_commit is the commit at which the graph was last checked against the imports (ed6dacb, WU-0001.4). 2026-10-10 (WU-0002.2, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the identifiers row (no imports) was added by hand with lpcstudy/identifiers.py, and the analysis, experiments and report edges to identifiers by hand with the imports (WU-0002.2); source_commit is the commit that added the identifiers row, checked against the imports of the following commit by reading them. 2026-10-11 (WU-0002.6(a), developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the allocation and analysis edges to data were added by hand from the new 'from .data import sklearn_seed' imports (DEF-0010); source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-11 (WU-0002.6(b), developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the experiments row gains data (make_rng for the H2a robustness bootstrap) and loses statistics (block_bootstrap and partial_correlation are no longer imported there), by hand from the imports of lpcstudy/experiments.py. 2026-10-11 (WU-0002.4-5 phase 2, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the edge analysis -> data was added by hand with the import of make_rng in lpcstudy/analysis.py (H1a, H1b and H1d bootstraps, DEC-0012); the edge already existed from the sklearn_seed import after the merge with develop; no module was added, so the module count is unchanged. 2026-10-11 (WU-0002.6 merge with develop, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the union of the two branches' rows was checked by reading the import statements of all 21 lpcstudy/*.py after the merge (including function-level 'from .allocation import' in analysis.py and 'from . import analysis as an' in experiments.py): analysis -> allocation, config, data, identifiers, oracle, pipeline, statistics; experiments -> allocation, analysis, config, data, dynamics, ensemble, identifiers, oracle, pipeline, validation (no statistics); no other row changed; module count 21; source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-11 (WU-0002.9, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the edge report -> statistics was added by hand with the new 'from .statistics import overall_verdict' in lpcstudy/report.py, and the imports of all 21 lpcstudy/*.py were read again; no other row changed; module count 21; source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-11 (WU-0005.5b, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the edge experiments -> embedding was added by hand with the new 'from .embedding import delay_vectors' in lpcstudy/experiments.py (P2(c) wiring); the imports of validation.py (new names from ensemble: retrieval_spread, worker_count; scipy is external) and report.py were read again and gave no other change; module count 21; source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-11 (WU-0001.6, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the edge experiments -> provenance was added by hand with the new 'from .provenance import array_digest' in lpcstudy/experiments.py (context_record); the imports of provenance.py (config only; numpy and scipy are external), data.py (unchanged: state_cov adds no import), report.py and __main__.py were read again and gave no other change; module count 21; source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-11 (WU-0008.3, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the new module budget.py was added by hand with the edges budget -> config and budget -> identifiers (its two 'from .x import' lines), and the edge report -> budget with the new 'from .budget import' in lpcstudy/report.py; the imports of report.py were read again and gave no other change; module count 22; source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-12 (WU-0002.11e, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the new module clip_sensitivity.py was added by hand with its imports (from . import analysis; from .allocation, .config, .data, .ensemble, .oracle, .statistics), and the edges experiments -> clip_sensitivity and report -> clip_sensitivity with the new imports in lpcstudy/experiments.py and lpcstudy/report.py; the imports of ensemble.py and pipeline.py (edited, no new import) were read again and gave no other change; module count 23; source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-14 (WU-0003.7a, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): three edges to provenance were added by hand with the new 'from .provenance import array_digest' in lpcstudy/data.py and lpcstudy/networks.py and 'from .provenance import index_digest' in lpcstudy/allocation.py (the trajectory, weight and leaf digests); the imports of experiments.py (new function, no new import) and pipeline.py (no import change) were read again and gave no other change; provenance.py still imports config only, so there is no cycle; module count 23; source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-14 (WU-0003.7b, developer claude-sonnet-5-5): the new module dump.py was added by hand with its imports (from .allocation import deployable_profile; from .config import StudyConfig; from .data import SPLITS; from .ensemble import DRAW_COUNTERS, ENTRY_COUNTERS; from .oracle import oracle_weight; no import of pipeline, analysis or experiments, so there is no cycle), and the edges __main__, analysis, experiments and pipeline to dump with their new 'from .dump import' lines; the imports of ensemble.py (a new keyword argument, no import change) were read again and gave no other change; module count 24; source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-25 (WU-0039a, developer claude-opus-5-5): the edge estimation -> systems was added by hand with the new 'from .systems import SINGLE_START, check_starts' in lpcstudy/estimation.py (the per-system estimator starts); systems.py still imports nothing from the package, so there is no cycle; the imports of pipeline.py (no import change) were read again and gave no other change; module count 24; source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-26 (WU-0048, developer claude-opus-5-5): the new module contribution.py was added by hand from its import statements (module level: from .ablation, .data, .statistics; function level: from .ablation import PROFILE_LEVEL, profile_ablation_block); no module imports it, so there is no cycle; module count 25 (26 stems with __init__); source_commit is not advanced. 2026-10-26 (WU-0049, developer claude-opus-5-5): the new modules joint_decisions.py and mechanisms.py were added by hand from their import statements (joint_decisions: from . import contribution; from .ablation, .mechanisms, .oracle, .statistics; mechanisms: from .ablation, .contribution, .data, .statistics); no module of the package imports either, and mechanisms does not import joint_decisions, so there is no cycle; module count 27 (28 stems with __init__); source_commit is not advanced.
